recipe.title: Roast chicken with lemon, tomatoes and olives

i.n: chicken thigh fillets, boneless and skinless

method.s: Place the chicken thighs in a casserole dish and top with oregano, lemon juice and zest, a drizzle of olive oil, salt and cracked pepper.
Surround the chicken with cherry tomatoes and olives.
Bake for 30 minutes, until the chicken is cooked through.
Serve with a leafy green salad and some crusty bread.
